create_donut_swin_model: create a DonutSwinModel instance for image feature extraction with optional pooling and masked token support
run_image_classification: run image classification with DonutSwinForImageClassification using pixel values and optional labels for loss computation
encode_images: encode images through DonutSwinEncoder to produce hidden states, attentions, and reshaped hidden states
partition_windows: partition input features into sliding windows for windowed self-attention computation in Swin Transformer
interpolate_position_encoding: interpolate pre-trained position embeddings to support higher resolution images in DonutSwinEmbeddings
